headings.weight: font-normal to font-medium (Avoid heavy bolding for luxury feel)

labels.style: text-xs md:text-sm font-sans uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-navy/60 font-semibold

visual_enhancers.shadows: Very subtle. Use shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(10,25,47,0.04)] instead of default drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders using border-navy/10 or border-cream/10. No thick borders.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: Sharp corners (rounded-none) or very minimal (rounded-sm). Luxury leans structural.
visual_enhancers.textures: Use noise overlay on dark Navy sections to add velvet/matte depth. E.g., a fixed div with opacity-5 mix-blend-overlay.

buttons.primary: bg-gold text-navy font-sans uppercase tracking-widest text-sm px-8 py-4 rounded-none hover:bg-gold-hover transition-colors duration-300
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-navy border border-navy/20 font-sans uppercase tracking-widest text-sm px-8 py-4 rounded-none hover:border-navy transition-colors duration-300

inputs.style: bg-transparent border-b border-navy/20 rounded-none px-0 py-3 focus:ring-0 focus:border-gold transition-colors font-sans text-navy placeholder:text-navy/40

cards.style: bg-cream-100 border border-navy/5 p-8 hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform duration-500
cards.alternative: Cardless editorial layout: Image + overlapping text block, no containing box.

accordion.style: border-b border-navy/10 py-4. Serif text for questions, sans for answers. Plus/minus icon over chevrons.

grid.bento_asymmetric: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Mix col-span-4, col-span-8 to avoid perfect symmetry.

motion.page_scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling (MANDATORY for premium feel)
motion.reveals: Framer Motion: Initial opacity 0, y 20, duration 0.8s, ease [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1]. Stagger children.
motion.parallax: Subtle y-axis translation on images on scroll. Do not overdo it.
motion.image_hover: Scale image 1.05 inside overflow-hidden container. Slow transition (duration-700).

artwork_handling.challenge: It is a portrait poster with a cream border. Do not stretch to full-bleed landscape.
artwork_handling.desktop_strategy: Split the hero or use a blended edge. Set the Hero background to `bg-navy`. Place text on the left. On the right, position the artwork absolutely or in a grid cell using `object-fit: contain` or `object-fit: cover` with `object-position: right top`. Apply a CSS mask: `mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent 0%, black 20%)` so it fades beautifully into the navy. Alternatively, display it as a majestic 'framed' piece of art on the right overlapping the next section.
artwork_handling.mobile_strategy: The screen is portrait, so the artwork fits well as `bg-cover`. Add a `bg-navy/70` overlay so the white/gold text remains accessible.

photography.style: Editorial, desaturated, high-contrast. Avoid bright generic stock colors. Use grayscale or sepia filters via CSS if an image clashes with the Navy/Gold palette (`grayscale contrast-125 mix-blend-luminosity opacity-80`).

residential.description: High-end white and brown living room, representing luxury residential moves.

commercial.description: Classic New Orleans concrete building, representing commercial moving.

specialty_packing.description: Close up of an antique safe/metal lock, representing fine art & specialty packing.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a Luxury Hospitality-style marketing site for a New Orleans moving company.
CRITICAL: Do NOT replace or recreate the artwork (`/public/brand/login-art.jpg`). Follow the specific handling strategies in `media.artwork_handling` to make it look premium.
CRITICAL: Do NOT use generic blue-and-white moving site tropes. Use the provided Tailwind tokens: navy, gold, cream.
Do NOT use standard rounded Shadcn cards. Strip all border-radius to `rounded-none`. Use 1px borders.
Ensure Header has a background (`bg-cream/90 backdrop-blur-md`). Do NOT use a fully transparent header.
Implement the 'Get Free Estimate' short form in the Hero or right below it. Do NOT use default HTML inputs; use styled pure Tailwind inputs that look like high-end luxury forms (border-bottom only).

Section Flow: Hero -> Trust/Why Us -> Services (Editorial list, not grids of generic boxes) -> Our Process (Minimalist timeline) -> Reviews (Large serif blockquotes) -> Area/FAQ -> Estimate CTA Block -> Footer.
All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="hero-estimate-cta"`).
Ensure accessibility (WCAG AA). Navy text on Cream is perfect. White/Cream text on Navy is perfect. Do not put Navy on Navy or Gold on White without checking contrast.
universal_guidelines: You MUST NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., `transition: all`). Target specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Use natural left-aligned typography.
Never use AI assistant emojis. Use `lucide-react` or `@phosphor-icons/react`.
Layered design: Use z-index for overlapping editorial layouts.
No placeholder URLs for images. Use only the provided image_urls.
